description: This file defines a C# interface for a grain in the Orleans framework, specifying asynchronous methods for obtaining readers and writers and setting them, associated with a multi-facet factory pattern.

classes.name: IMultifacetFactoryTestGrain
classes.description: An interface for a multifacet factory grain in Orleans, providing methods to get and set reader/writer objects.

methods.name: GetReader
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an IMultifacetReader instance, optionally based on a given grain.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an IMultifacetWriter instance, optionally based on a given grain.
